12: - Discriminator menerima gambar `[B, 1, 28, 28]` dan label `[B]`; MLP mengeluarkan satu logit per sampel `[B, 1]`.
13: - Gunakan `BCEWithLogitsLoss`; Discriminator mengembalikan logits tanpa sigmoid.

31: 2. Output Generator finite dan berada pada rentang `[-1,1]`.

# Rancangan Arsitektur

## Tujuan

Membangun conditional GAN MLP dari komponen dasar PyTorch untuk menghasilkan Fashion-MNIST grayscale berukuran 28×28 pada 10 kelas. Model pretrained dan implementasi GAN siap pakai tidak digunakan.

## Komponen dan keputusan

- Conditioning label menggunakan one-hot vektor berdimensi 10, digabung dengan noise pada Generator dan representasi gambar pada Discriminator.
- Noise Generator berbentuk `[B, 100]`; label integer berbentuk `[B]` dengan rentang `0..9`.
- Generator menggunakan lapisan `Linear` dan ReLU, lalu output 784 unit dengan `Tanh`, dibentuk menjadi `[B, 1, 28, 28]`.
- Discriminator menerima gambar `[B, 1, 28, 28]` dan label `[B]`; MLP mengeluarkan satu logit per sampel `[B, 1]`.
- Gunakan `BCEWithLogitsLoss`; Discriminator mengembalikan logits tanpa sigmoid.
- Dataset mengubah intensitas gambar ke `[-1, 1]`, selaras dengan `Tanh` Generator.
- Seed awal `42`. Reproducibility juga memerlukan pengaturan generator NumPy/PyTorch, DataLoader, dan backend deterministik sesuai dukungan perangkat. Determinisme penuh dapat mengurangi kecepatan dan tidak selalu identik lintas perangkat/versi.

## Kontrak modul

| Modul | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Dataset/DataLoader | Fashion-MNIST | gambar float `[B,1,28,28]` dalam `[-1,1]`; label integer `[B]`, `0..9` |
| Generator | noise `[B,100]`; label `[B]` | gambar `[B,1,28,28]` dalam `[-1,1]` |
| Discriminator | gambar `[B,1,28,28]`; label `[B]` | logits `[B,1]` |
| Training loop | batch gambar/label dan model | optimasi D lalu G; loss/metrik; checkpoint bila ditambahkan |

`B` berarti ukuran batch yang sama pada satu forward pass. Device dan tipe tensor harus konsisten.

## Rencana uji model

1. Bentuk output Generator dan Discriminator benar untuk batch kecil serta batch satu.
2. Output Generator finite dan berada pada rentang `[-1,1]`.
3. Output Discriminator finite dan berbentuk satu logit per gambar.
4. **Conditioning label:** dengan bobot tetap dan noise/gambar yang sama, uji bahwa perubahan label masuk ke jalur conditioning; gunakan pengujian sensitivitas eksplisit setelah arsitektur ditetapkan. Tes tidak boleh mengasumsikan output acak pasti berbeda tanpa mengontrol bobot.
5. **Gradient flow:** loss sintetis dirambatkan melalui masing-masing model; pastikan parameter yang dapat dilatih mendapat gradient finite dan tidak seluruhnya nol.
6. Tes kontrak data: bentuk, dtype, rentang normalisasi, dan label valid.

## Trade-off

MLP sederhana dan mudah diinspeksi, cocok untuk baseline akademik. Ia tidak memanfaatkan struktur spasial sebaik CNN; bila hasil baseline tidak memadai, perubahan arsitektur dilakukan sebagai eksperimen terpisah dan didokumentasikan.

## Dasar rancangan

`docs/architecture.md` menetapkan **MLP cGAN PyTorch**, Fashion-MNIST grayscale 28×28, 10 kelas. Conditioning label berupa one-hot; Generator memakai `Tanh`; Discriminator menghasilkan logit tanpa sigmoid, untuk dipakai bersama `BCEWithLogitsLoss`.

`docs/implementation-plan.md` menetapkan area Anggota 1: `src/fashion_cgan/models.py`, `tests/test_models.py`, serta rancangan arsitektur. Pipeline data, training, konfigurasi eksperimen, evaluasi, dan dokumentasi umum milik anggota lain—tidak disentuh. Saya membaca README, konfigurasi, panduan log, dan catatan sesi awal sebagai konteks. Tidak membuat log sesi baru.

## Rencana implementasi

- **Generator:** input noise `[B,100]` dan label integer `[B]` bernilai `0..9`. Ubah label menjadi one-hot `[B,10]`, gabungkan dengan noise menjadi `[B,110]`. MLP `Linear` + ReLU, lapisan akhir 784 unit + `Tanh`, lalu bentuk ulang menjadi `[B,1,28,28]` dengan nilai `[-1,1]`.
- **Discriminator:** input gambar `[B,1,28,28]` dan label `[B]`. Ratakan gambar menjadi `[B,784]`, gabungkan dengan one-hot label menjadi `[B,794]`. MLP `Linear` + ReLU, keluaran satu logit per sampel `[B,1]`. Tidak menambahkan sigmoid.
- **Antarmuka:** kedua model menjaga ukuran batch, dtype, dan device tensor tetap konsisten. Noise, label, gambar mengikuti kontrak arsitektur yang sudah ada; tidak mengubah konfigurasi anggota lain.

## Pengujian yang direncanakan

`tests/test_models.py` memeriksa bentuk output untuk batch kecil dan batch satu, rentang serta finiteness output Generator, dan bentuk serta finiteness logit Discriminator. Uji conditioning memastikan label benar-benar masuk ke jalur model dengan bobot/noise atau gambar terkontrol—bukan mengandalkan keluaran acak yang kebetulan berbeda. Uji gradient flow memeriksa gradient parameter finite dan tidak seluruhnya nol. Setelah model siap, uji bersama kontrak bentuk, dtype, normalisasi, dan rentang label dari data; implementasi pipeline tetap tanggung jawab Anggota 2.

--- src/fashion_cgan/models.py	
+++ src/fashion_cgan/models.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+"""MLP models for the Fashion-MNIST conditional GAN."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+
+class Generator(nn.Module):
+    """Generate 28x28 grayscale images from noise and class labels."""
+
+    def __init__(self, latent_dim: int = 100, num_classes: int = 10) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.latent_dim = latent_dim
+        self.num_classes = num_classes
+        self.network = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(latent_dim + num_classes, 256),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(256, 512),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(512, 28 * 28),
+            nn.Tanh(),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, noise: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not isinstance(noise, torch.Tensor) or noise.ndim != 2 or noise.shape[1] != self.latent_dim:
+            raise ValueError(f"noise must have shape [B, {self.latent_dim}]")
+        _validate_labels(labels, noise.shape[0], noise.device, self.num_classes)
+        conditioned = torch.cat((noise, F.one_hot(labels, self.num_classes).to(noise.dtype)), dim=1)
+        return self.network(conditioned).view(noise.shape[0], 1, 28, 28)
+
+
+class Discriminator(nn.Module):
+    """Score grayscale images conditioned on class labels; returns logits."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_classes: int = 10) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_classes = num_classes
+        self.network = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(28 * 28 + num_classes, 512),
+            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(512, 256),
+            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(256, 1),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, images: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if images.ndim != 4 or tuple(images.shape[1:]) != (1, 28, 28):
+            raise ValueError("images must have shape [B, 1, 28, 28]")
+        _validate_labels(labels, images.shape[0], images.device, self.num_classes)
+        conditioned = torch.cat(
+            (images.flatten(start_dim=1), F.one_hot(labels, self.num_classes).to(images.dtype)), dim=1
+        )
+        return self.network(conditioned)
+
+
+def _validate_labels(labels: torch.Tensor, batch_size: int | None, device: torch.device, num_classes: int) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(labels, torch.Tensor) or labels.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("labels must be a rank-1 integer tensor")
+    if batch_size is not None and labels.shape[0] != batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("labels and inputs must have the same batch size")
+    if labels.device != device:
+        raise ValueError("labels and inputs must be on the same device")
+    if labels.dtype not in (torch.uint8, torch.int8, torch.int16, torch.int32, torch.int64):
+        raise ValueError("labels must use an integer dtype")
+    if torch.any((labels < 0) | (labels >= num_classes)).item():
+        raise ValueError(f"labels must be in the range 0..{num_classes - 1}")

--- tests/test_models.py	
+++ tests/test_models.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from fashion_cgan.models import Discriminator, Generator
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch_size", [1, 4])
+def test_generator_shape_and_range(batch_size):
+    model = Generator()
+    images = model(torch.randn(batch_size, 100), torch.arange(batch_size) % 10)
+
+    assert images.shape == (batch_size, 1, 28, 28)
+    assert torch.isfinite(images).all()
+    assert images.min() >= -1 and images.max() <= 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch_size", [1, 4])
+def test_discriminator_returns_one_finite_logit_per_image(batch_size):
+    model = Discriminator()
+    logits = model(torch.randn(batch_size, 1, 28, 28), torch.arange(batch_size) % 10)
+
+    assert logits.shape == (batch_size, 1)
+    assert torch.isfinite(logits).all()
+
+
+def test_both_models_use_label_conditioning():
+    generator = Generator()
+    discriminator = Discriminator()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for model in (generator, discriminator):
+            for parameter in model.parameters():
+                parameter.zero_()
+            model.network[0].weight[0, -10] = 1
+            model.network[0].bias[0] = -0.5
+            model.network[2].weight[0, 0] = 1
+            model.network[2].bias[0] = 0.5
+            model.network[4].weight[0, 0] = 1
+        generator.network[-2].weight[0, 0] = 1
+        discriminator.network[-1].weight[0, 0] = 1
+
+    noise = torch.zeros(1, 100)
+    image = torch.zeros(1, 1, 28, 28)
+    generated_zero = generator(noise, torch.tensor([0]))
+    generated_one = generator(noise, torch.tensor([1]))
+    score_zero = discriminator(image, torch.tensor([0]))
+    score_one = discriminator(image, torch.tensor([1]))
+
+    assert not torch.equal(generated_zero, generated_one)
+    assert not torch.equal(score_zero, score_one)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_kind", ["generator", "discriminator"])
+def test_models_have_finite_nonzero_parameter_gradients(model_kind):
+    if model_kind == "generator":
+        model = Generator()
+        output = model(torch.randn(3, 100), torch.tensor([1, 4, 8]))
+    else:
+        model = Discriminator()
+        output = model(torch.randn(3, 1, 28, 28), torch.tensor([1, 4, 8]))
+    output.square().mean().backward()
+
+    gradients = [parameter.grad for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad]
+    assert all(gradient is not None and torch.isfinite(gradient).all() for gradient in gradients)
+    assert any(torch.count_nonzero(gradient) for gradient in gradients)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("noise", "labels", "message"),
+    [
+        (torch.randn(2, 99), torch.tensor([0, 1]), "noise must have shape"),
+        (torch.randn(2, 100), torch.tensor([0]), "same batch size"),
+        (torch.randn(2, 100), torch.tensor([0, 10]), "range"),
+        (torch.randn(2, 100), torch.tensor([0.0, 1.0]), "integer dtype"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_generator_rejects_invalid_inputs(noise, labels, message):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):
+        Generator()(noise, labels)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("images", "labels", "message"),
+    [
+        (torch.randn(2, 28, 28), torch.tensor([0, 1]), "images must have shape"),
+        (torch.randn(2, 1, 28, 28), torch.tensor([0]), "same batch size"),
+        (torch.randn(2, 1, 28, 28), torch.tensor([-1, 1]), "range"),
+        (torch.randn(2, 1, 28, 28), torch.tensor([0.0, 1.0]), "integer dtype"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_discriminator_rejects_invalid_inputs(images, labels, message):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):
+        Discriminator()(images, labels)

import pytest
import torch

from fashion_cgan.models import Discriminator, Generator


@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch_size", [1, 4])
def test_generator_shape_and_range(batch_size):
    model = Generator()
    images = model(torch.randn(batch_size, 100), torch.arange(batch_size) % 10)

    assert images.shape == (batch_size, 1, 28, 28)
    assert torch.isfinite(images).all()
    assert images.min() >= -1 and images.max() <= 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch_size", [1, 4])
def test_discriminator_returns_one_finite_logit_per_image(batch_size):
    model = Discriminator()
    logits = model(torch.randn(batch_size, 1, 28, 28), torch.arange(batch_size) % 10)

    assert logits.shape == (batch_size, 1)
    assert torch.isfinite(logits).all()


def test_both_models_use_label_conditioning():
    generator = Generator()
    discriminator = Discriminator()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for model in (generator, discriminator):
            for parameter in model.parameters():
                parameter.zero_()
            model.network[0].weight[0, -10] = 1
            model.network[0].bias[0] = -0.5
            model.network[2].weight[0, 0] = 1
            model.network[2].bias[0] = 0.5
            model.network[4].weight[0, 0] = 1
        generator.network[-2].weight[0, 0] = 1
        discriminator.network[-1].weight[0, 0] = 1

    noise = torch.zeros(1, 100)
    image = torch.zeros(1, 1, 28, 28)
    generated_zero = generator(noise, torch.tensor([0]))
    generated_one = generator(noise, torch.tensor([1]))
    score_zero = discriminator(image, torch.tensor([0]))
    score_one = discriminator(image, torch.tensor([1]))

    assert not torch.equal(generated_zero, generated_one)
    assert not torch.equal(score_zero, score_one)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_kind", ["generator", "discriminator"])
def test_models_have_finite_nonzero_parameter_gradients(model_kind):
    if model_kind == "generator":
        model = Generator()
        output = model(torch.randn(3, 100), torch.tensor([1, 4, 8]))
    else:
        model = Discriminator()
        output = model(torch.randn(3, 1, 28, 28), torch.tensor([1, 4, 8]))
    output.square().mean().backward()

    gradients = [parameter.grad for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad]
    assert all(gradient is not None and torch.isfinite(gradient).all() for gradient in gradients)
    assert any(torch.count_nonzero(gradient) for gradient in gradients)

+"""MLP models for the Fashion-MNIST conditional GAN."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+
+class Generator(nn.Module):
+    """Generate 28x28 grayscale images from noise and class labels."""
+
+    def __init__(self, latent_dim: int = 100, num_classes: int = 10) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.latent_dim = latent_dim
+        self.num_classes = num_classes
+        self.network = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(latent_dim + num_classes, 256),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(256, 512),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(512, 28 * 28),
+            nn.Tanh(),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, noise: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not isinstance(noise, torch.Tensor) or noise.ndim != 2 or noise.shape[1] != self.latent_dim:
+            raise ValueError(f"noise must have shape [B, {self.latent_dim}]")
+        _validate_labels(labels, noise.shape[0], noise.device, self.num_classes)
+        conditioned = torch.cat((noise, F.one_hot(labels, self.num_classes).to(noise.dtype)), dim=1)
+        return self.network(conditioned).view(noise.shape[0], 1, 28, 28)
+
+
+class Discriminator(nn.Module):
+    """Score grayscale images conditioned on class labels; returns logits."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_classes: int = 10) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_classes = num_classes
+        self.network = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(28 * 28 + num_classes, 512),
+            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(512, 256),
+            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(256, 1),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, images: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if images.ndim != 4 or tuple(images.shape[1:]) != (1, 28, 28):
+            raise ValueError("images must have shape [B, 1, 28, 28]")
+        _validate_labels(labels, images.shape[0], images.device, self.num_classes)
+        conditioned = torch.cat(
+            (images.flatten(start_dim=1), F.one_hot(labels, self.num_classes).to(images.dtype)), dim=1
+        )
+        return self.network(conditioned)
+
+
+def _validate_labels(labels: torch.Tensor, batch_size: int | None, device: torch.device, num_classes: int) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(labels, torch.Tensor) or labels.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("labels must be a rank-1 integer tensor")
+    if batch_size is not None and labels.shape[0] != batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("labels and inputs must have the same batch size")
+    if labels.device != device:
+        raise ValueError("labels and inputs must be on the same device")
+    if labels.dtype not in (torch.uint8, torch.int8, torch.int16, torch.int32, torch.int64):
+        raise ValueError("labels must use an integer dtype")
+    if torch.any((labels < 0) | (labels >= num_classes)).item():
+        raise ValueError(f"labels must be in the range 0..{num_classes - 1}")

+"""MLP models for the Fashion-MNIST conditional GAN."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+
+class Generator(nn.Module):
+    """Generate 28x28 grayscale images from noise and class labels."""
+
+    def __init__(self, latent_dim: int = 100, num_classes: int = 10) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.latent_dim = latent_dim
+        self.num_classes = num_classes
+        self.network = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(latent_dim + num_classes, 256),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(256, 512),
+            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(512, 28 * 28),
+            nn.Tanh(),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, noise: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not isinstance(noise, torch.Tensor) or noise.ndim != 2 or noise.shape[1] != self.latent_dim:
+            raise ValueError(f"noise must have shape [B, {self.latent_dim}]")
+        _validate_labels(labels, noise.shape[0], noise.device, self.num_classes)
+        conditioned = torch.cat((noise, F.one_hot(labels, self.num_classes).to(noise.dtype)), dim=1)
+        return self.network(conditioned).view(noise.shape[0], 1, 28, 28)
+
+
+class Discriminator(nn.Module):
+    """Score grayscale images conditioned on class labels; returns logits."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_classes: int = 10) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_classes = num_classes
+        self.network = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(28 * 28 + num_classes, 512),
+            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(512, 256),
+            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
+            nn.Linear(256, 1),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, images: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if images.ndim != 4 or tuple(images.shape[1:]) != (1, 28, 28):
+            raise ValueError("images must have shape [B, 1, 28, 28]")
+        _validate_labels(labels, images.shape[0], images.device, self.num_classes)
+        conditioned = torch.cat(
+            (images.flatten(start_dim=1), F.one_hot(labels, self.num_classes).to(images.dtype)), dim=1
+        )
+        return self.network(conditioned)
+
+
+def _validate_labels(labels: torch.Tensor, batch_size: int | None, device: torch.device, num_classes: int) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(labels, torch.Tensor) or labels.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("labels must be a rank-1 integer tensor")
+    if batch_size is not None and labels.shape[0] != batch_size:
+        raise ValueError("labels and inputs must have the same batch size")
+    if labels.device != device:
+        raise ValueError("labels and inputs must be on the same device")
+    if labels.dtype not in (torch.uint8, torch.int8, torch.int16, torch.int32, torch.int64):
+        raise ValueError("labels must use an integer dtype")
+    if torch.any((labels < 0) | (labels >= num_classes)).item():
+        raise ValueError(f"labels must be in the range 0..{num_classes - 1}")
